name: restreamair
description: Dependencies for the ReStreamAir panel executable. Only Windows uses this: macOS and Linux take libcurl and libxml2 from the system, where both are a package-manager line away. On Windows there is no such source, so the two are built from a manifest into a static triplet and linked in — which is what makes the release a single restreamair.exe with no DLLs beside it.

dependencies.name: curl
dependencies.comment: Schannel rather than OpenSSL: it is the platform's own TLS stack, so certificate validation follows the machine's trust store and no CA bundle has to ship alongside the exe. http2 matters as much here as it does on Linux — see the HTTP/2 note in apps/server/net.c.
